snippet.title: PSN minis - Dynogems
snippet.description:
http://eu.playstation.com/psn/games/detail/item254973/Dynogems/

Cause explosions galore as you arrange your jewels by colour and collect magic items

- Make fantastic combinations when you organise and regroup jewels of the same colour, setting off multiple explosions and chain reactions. 
- Clear the screen when you get the right jewel in the right place at the right time. 
- A light-hearted and challenging puzzle game that is fun for people of all ages.
